exposure: Infants born to women with HIV
cohort: Pregnant women and infants born to women with HIV in Sweden.
finding: The updated Swedish guidelines on HIV management in pregnancy recommend early and continuous ART, dolutegravir/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF as first-line treatment, mode of delivery based on HIV RNA level, and updated infant antiretroviral prophylaxis recommendations.
mod_finding: Caesarean section is recommended if HIV RNA >=200 copies/ml; mode of delivery for women with effective ART and HIV RNA <200 copies/ml should follow standard obstetric procedures.
